blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Some properties of languages, e.g., subject-object-verb (SOV) word order, are more prevalent than others among the thousands of attested natural languages (NLs).
Such typological commonality is often attributed to learning biases. Computational simulations, recently with language models (LMs), have facilitated the exploration of this theory.
In this paper, we extend existing analyses of the relationship between LMs’ learning biases and typological commonality on both data and model sides, focusing on: (i) cross-serial dependencies, the upper limit of attested syntactic complexity, and (ii) stack-based LMs (SLMs), potentially facilitating learning of hierarchical patterns.
We first evaluate generalization of SLMs on cross-serial dependencies across diverse artificial languages and confirm that they struggle with such constructions.
However, SLMs with limited working memory generalize better suggesting a possible basis for such inductive bias and thus the typological commonality of some word order configurations.
blocks.zh:
语言的一些属性,如主题-对象-动词(SOV)词序,在数千种经认证的自然语言(NLs)中比其他的更为普遍.
这种类型共性往往归因于学习偏见。 计算模拟,最近与语言模型(LMs)一起,促进了这一理论的探索.
在本文中,我们将关于LMs学习偏差与类型共性之间关系的现有分析扩展至数据和模型两侧,重点是:(一) 跨序列依赖性、经证实的合成复杂性的上限,以及(二) 基于堆栈的LMs(SLMs),有可能促进等级模式的学习。
我们首先评价可持续土地管理在各种人工语言的跨序列依赖性方面的普遍化,并证实它们与这种构思有抵触。
然而,工作记忆有限的可持续土地管理更能说明这种诱导性偏差的可能依据,从而表明某些词序配置在类型上的共性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Attested natural languages (NLs) exhibit both typological commonalities and considerable diversity. NLs are widely believed to be mildly context-sensitive Shieber (1985) ; Li et al. (2024) , yet they vary along numerous dimensions, including word order.
Such features are not randomly distributed; for example, Subject-Object-Verb (SOV) base word order is substantially more common than Object-Subject-Verb (OSV) order, reflecting skewed typological tendencies.
blocks.zh:
经测试的自然语言既表现出类型上的共性,也表现出相当大的多样性。 人们普遍认为NLs温和地对上下文有敏感认识的Shieber(1985年);Li等人(2024年),然而它们却在包括词序在内的多个维度上有所不同.
这类特征不是随机分布的;例如,Object-Object-Verb(SOV)基词顺序比Object-Subject-Verb(OSV)顺序普遍得多,反映了偏斜的排字倾向.

blocks.en:
Linguists have argued that such skewed typological distributions could be attributed to learning bias Kirby et al. (2008) ; Culbertson (2012) : grammars that are easier to learn are more likely to survive successive (re-)learning.
Although learning bias here refers to human learners, language models (LMs) have been used to evaluate and refine this theory.
Recent work, for example, has used LMs, as a tool, to isolate the contribution of domain-general learning biases in simulations of typological patterns Xu et al. (2025) .
More broadly, LMs and computational simulations enable controlled manipulations of language learning conditions that would be ethically or practically infeasible in human experiments Warstadt and Bowman (2022) , thereby providing a proof-of-concept for linguistic hypotheses that have not been quantitatively tested Kallini et al. (2024) ; Kuribayashi et al. (2024) ; El-Naggar et al. (2025b) ; Yang et al. (2025) ; Hunter (2025) .
blocks.zh:
语言学家认为,这种扭曲的类型分布可归因于学习偏差Kirby等人(2008年);Culbertson (2012):比较容易学习的语法更可能持续(再)学习。
虽然这里的学习偏差指的是人类的学习者,但语言模型(LMs)被用来评价和完善这一理论.
例如,最近的工作将LMs作为一种工具,用来隔离域一般学习偏差在模拟类型学模式徐等人(2025年)中的贡献.
更广泛地说,LMs和计算模拟可以控制地操纵语言学习条件,在人类实验中,Warstadt和Bowman(2022年)在道德上或实际上不可行,从而为没有经过定量测试的语言假设提供概念证明;Kallini等人(2024年);Kuribayashi等人(2024年);El-Naggar等人(2025年b); 杨等 (2025); 亨特 (2025).

blocks.en:
Most LM-driven research on typological word-order distributions, like El-Naggar et al. (2025b) and Kuribayashi et al. (2024) , has used artificial languages (ALs).
Such ALs are simplified Someya et al. (2024) and lack the full attested complexity of NLs El-Naggar et al. (2025a) ; Xu et al. (2025) , such as cross-serial dependency (CSD) constructions.
CSDs are mildly context-sensitive constructions attested in some NLs Shieber (1985) ; Maclachlan and Rambow (2002) and generally taken to reflect the upper bound of syntactic complexity.
CSDs are exemplified with ‘Swiss-German’ sentences, such as We Hans the house helped paint , where the dependencies cross (as indicated by coloring).

大多数LM驱动的关于类型词序分布的研究,如El-Naggar等人(2025年b)和Kuribayashi等人(2024年),都使用了人工语言(ALs).
此类ALS被简化为Someya等人(2024年),缺乏NLs El-Naggar等人(2025年a年)的充分证明复杂性;徐等人(2025年),如跨周期依赖(CSD)构造.
CSD是一些NLs Shieber(1985年);Maclachlan和Rambow(2002年)中证实的温和上下文敏感构造,一般认为它反映了合成复杂性的上方界限。
CSD以 " 瑞士-德国 " 的句子为例,例如我们汉斯帮助了房子的绘画,其中的依赖性交叉(如彩色所示)。

blocks.en:
Certain stack-based language models (SLMs) are theoretically capable of learning some mildly context-sensitive languages and all context-free grammars DuSell and Chiang (2023) , roughly matching the structural complexity observed in NLs.
SLMs have also been shown to exhibit greater data efficiency DuSell and Chiang (2024) and hierarchical generalization DuSell and Cotterell (2025) .
But this research does not address whether SLMs can empirically generalize to CSDs in more realistic ALs rather than on a binary mirror language { w ​ w ′ ww^{\prime} | w ∈ { 0 , 1 } ∗ w\in\{0,1\}^{*} } DuSell and Chiang (2023) , and, if so, what detailed inductive biases they exhibit.
blocks.zh:
某些基于堆栈的语言模型(SLMs)理论上能够学习一些温和的对上下文敏感的语言和所有无上下文的语法DuSell和Chiang (2023),大致符合NLs观察到的结构复杂性.
可持续土地管理还证明,DuSell和Chiang(2024年)和分级概括DuSell和Cottell(2025年)的数据效率更高。
但是,这一研究没有涉及可持续土地管理是否能够以更现实的ALs,而不是用二进制镜像语言{ww′prime}在经验上向CSD概括,而不是用{w wprime} { {0, 1}} {w\in\{0, 1\}^{*}}杜塞尔和蒋(2023年),如果是这样,他们表现出什么详细的诱导性偏见。

blocks.en:
In this study, we extend existing LM-driven research on typological word-order distributions Kuribayashi et al. (2024) ; El-Naggar et al. (2025b) to address three main research questions: first, how do different LM architectures and stack representations affect LM generalization to increasingly complex cross-serial dependencies (CSD) constructions? Second, how does the interaction between the underlying LM architecture and stack representation affect generalization?
Finally, how do the learning biases of these models over word-order configurations align with the typological distributions observed for natural languages?
blocks.zh:
在这项研究中,我们扩展了现有的关于类型学词序分布的LM驱动研究Kuribayashi等人(2024年);El-Naggar等人(2025年b年),以解决三个主要的研究问题:第一,不同的LM架构和堆栈表示如何影响LM的概括化,将日益复杂的跨序列依赖性构建(CSD)? 第二,基础的LM架构和堆栈表示之间的相互作用如何影响泛化?
最后,这些模型对词序配置的学习偏见如何与自然语言所观察到的类型分布相一致?

blocks.en: 2 Background
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en: 2.1 Artificial Languages
blocks.zh: 2.1 人工语言

blocks.en:
NLs differ from each other in many aspects, which makes it difficult to isolate specific linguistic properties by just comparing the learnability of different NLs.
As an alternative approach, artificial languages (ALs) are commonly used to simulate specific conditions for training and evaluating language learners, including both humans Kirby et al. (2008) and computational models Wang and Eisner (2016) ; Delétang et al. (2023) ; Someya et al. (2024) ; El-Naggar et al. (2025a) .
As discussed in Xu et al. (2025) , there are mainly two approaches to create ALs: (i) creating a counterfactual version of the NL corpus by applying modification rules, or (ii) developing a grammar to generate a corpus from scratch.
Both approaches have pros and cons.
The former will maintain rich and realistic properties in the NL corpus, but may retain errors and biases from rule-based modifications as well as many heterogeneous properties of the original NLs Hunter (2025) .
On the other hand, grammar-based corpus generation supports better control of the data, but potentially lacks realistic NL properties depending on the quality and comprehensiveness of the predefined grammar.
This study uses grammar-based AL generation but adds novel NL-like syntactic complexity, namely, various constructions with CSDs, into the training and test data.
blocks.zh:
NL在许多方面互不相同,这使得仅仅比较不同NL的可学习性就很难孤立特定语言属性.
作为一种替代方法,人工语言(ALs)通常用于模拟培训和评价语言学习者的具体条件,包括人类Kirby等人(2008年)和计算模型Wang和Eisner(2016年);Delétang等人(2023年);Somiya等人(2024年);El-Naggar等人(2025a年)。
如徐等人(2025年)所述,创建ALS主要有两种方法:(一)通过应用修改规则创建反事实版本的NLBA,或(二)制定语法从零开始生成一个BAB.
这两种方法都有利弊。
前者将保持NLburge中丰富而现实的属性,但可能保留基于规则的修改所产生的错误和偏见以及原始NLs Hunter(2025)的许多不同属性.
另一方面,基于语法的命题生成支持更好的数据控制,但根据预先定义的语法的质量和全面性,可能缺乏现实的NL属性.
本研究使用基于语法的AL生成法,但将新颖的NL相似的合成复杂性,即与CSD的各种构思,添加到培训和测试数据中.

blocks.en: 2.2 Typological Alignment of LMs
blocks.zh: 2.2 LMs 的分类对齐

blocks.en:
What universal properties do NLs have, and where do they come from?
This is a fundamental question
in linguistics and cognitive science Greenberg (1963) ; Comrie (1989) .
Recently, computational linguists have revisited this question using LMs Linzen et al. (2016) ; Hupkes et al. (2020) .
This revival was partly triggered by claims that the unlimited capacity of (Transformer) LMs makes them irrelevant to the scientific pursuit of identifying the boundary between possible and impossible language Marcus (2018) ; Bender and Koller (2020) .
In spite of this, empirical investigations show that LMs’ learning biases typically align with typologically plausible patterns, highlighting the potential role of domain-general learning biases for explaining typological commonality Xu et al. (2025) .
Recently, this research has been expanded using quantitative typological databases, e.g. WALS Dryer and Haspelmath (2013) , and the correlation between LMs’ performance and typological commonality has been studied more comprehensively.
Our study is also in line with such endeavors by extending two dimensions of AL complexity as well as testing LM variant models.
blocks.zh:
NLs有什么普遍性属性,它们来自何处?
这是一个根本性的问题
在语言学和认知科学方面,格林伯格(1963年);Comrie(1989年)。
最近,计算语言学家利用LMs Linzen等人(2016年);Hupkes等人(2020年)重新审视了这一问题。
这种复兴的部分原因是,有人声称(译者)LMs的无限能力使得它们与确定可能语言和不可能语言之间的界限的科学追求无关(2018年);Bender和Koller(2020年).
尽管如此,经验调查显示,LMs的学习偏差通常与类型学上可信的模式相一致,突出了域-一般学习偏差在解释类型共性方面的潜在作用Xu等人(2025年)。
最近,利用定量类型学数据库,例如WALS Dryer和Haspelmath(2013年),扩大了这一研究,并更全面地研究了LMs的性能与类型共性之间的关系。
我们的研究也符合这种努力,扩展了AL复杂性的两个层面,并测试了LM变体模型。

blocks.en: 2.3 Stack-Based LMs (SLMs)
blocks.zh: 2.3 基于堆栈的LMs(SLMs)

blocks.en:
Given the claim that human language generalization and processing are biased toward hierarchical structure Chomsky (1957) ; Zaccarella and Friederici (2017) , injecting structural bias into neural LMs has been explored.
Supervised syntactic LMs, such as recurrent neural network grammars (RNNGs) Dyer et al. (2016) , have been compared to base LMs Hale et al. (2018) ; Kuribayashi et al. (2024) , but the provision of syntactic annotation during training confounds the effect of supervision with model architecture.
blocks.zh:
鉴于有人声称人类语言的概括和处理偏向于等级结构乔姆斯基(1957年);Zaccarella和Friederici(2017年),人们探索了将结构偏向注入神经LM.
监督合成LMs,如经常性神经网络语法(RNNGs) Dyer等人(2016年),与Base LMs Hale等人(2018年);Kuribayashi等人(2024年)进行了比较,但在培训期间提供综合注释,混淆了监督与示范建筑的效果。

blocks.en:
SLMs are one variant, where stack-based memory is implemented as a differentiable sub-module, emulating a push-down automaton (PDA) facilitating the processing of hierarchically nested structures characteristic of context-free languages (CFLs).
Following DuSell and Cotterell (2025) , we test two SLM variants with superposition stacks (SUP) Joulin and Mikolov (2015) and nondeterministic stacks (ND) DuSell and Chiang (2024) using a standard LM self-supervised training regime.

继DuSell和Cottellell(2025年)之后,我们使用标准的LM自我监督培训制度,测试了两个带有叠置堆栈(SUP)的SLM变体和Mikolov(2015年)和非定型堆栈(ND)DuSell和Chiang(2024年).

blocks.en: 3.1 Generalized Categorial Grammar

blocks.en:
The ALs we use are based on generalized categorial grammar (GCG) Wood (2014) .
GCGs are an extension of categorial grammar (CG).
CG is made up of a lexicon, where each word is assigned a functor or basic category, and rules that determine how categories are combined syntactically and semantically.
The different categories are represented using slash notation, which indicates the position of the argument with respect to the resulting category, i.e., whether the argument is on the left or right of the result.

We use a modified version of the NLTK Bird et al. (2009) CCGChartParser.
In this modified version of the NLTK CCGChartParser, type raising is disabled, and the permutation operation defined by Briscoe (1997) ; Briscoe (2000) is implemented.
Crossed composition is allowed in the modified parser, enabling it to parse CSD constructions and their natural extensions (CSD with relative clause, etc.).
This parser is used to parse the newly introduced templates and determine their validity.

AL corpora are created by filtering sentences generated from templates defining sequences of lexical categories using a GCG parser with language-specific sets of lexical syntactic categories.
Note that all our ALs have case markers, i.e., ga for subjective and o for accusative case, which will be used in example sentences. Lexical items are randomly selected to create sentences from templates based on their assignment to a single lexical category (i.e. there is no lexical syntactic ambiguity in our ALs).

For each AL, data are split into 70K Short (3-8 tokens) sentences in training data, 10K held-out Short validation data, 20K held-out Short test data, 20K Medium (9-10 tokens) test data, and 20K Long (10-20 tokens) test data.
Note that the simplest CSD construction with 3-NP 2-VP (e.g., We ga Hans ga house o helped paint ), is in the Short training set.
More complex ones, such as 4-NP 3-VP or CSD with some modifiers, are in the longer test data.
The modifications made to extend CSD constructions for the Medium and Long test sets are detailed in Algorithm 1 creating additional templates.

blocks.en:
Third, we limited the base word order variations to SOV and VOS; that is, the parameters determining subject, object, and verb are merged into a single binary parameter (0 for SOV, 1 for VOS).
This is because CSD constructions are only attested in SOV and VOS languages Shieber (1985) ; Maclachlan and Rambow (2002) , and therefore, it becomes less obvious how to emulate CSD constructions for other base word orders, and targeted evaluations cannot be designed in a manner informed by attested languages.
Other parameters, such as adjective word order, are systematically controlled, resulting in 32 ALs and 5 word order parameters ( 2 5 = 32 2^{5}=32 ).
Word order configuration is denoted by a 5-digit binary code (Table 2 ); for example, Japanese-like fully head-final word order is 00000 .

blocks.en: 3.4 CSD-Focused Generalization Test Sets

blocks.en:
To evaluate whether (S)LMs generalize to complex constructions, specifically the combination of CSDs and other syntactically complex ones, e.g., object relative clauses, we create four versions of evaluation data with specific constructions.
Figure 1 illustrates the four constructions targeted in this study.
All the templates expand the basic 3-NP 2-VP and 4-NP 3-VP CSD constructions. Rel version introduces an object relative clause to one of the NPs in the base construction. Conj-1 and Conj-2 introduce a coordinate structure within the relative clause on top of the Rel version with one or two relativizers, respectively. Nested introduces one additional nested relative clause into the Rel version.
In all versions, lexical items of the appropriate categories are randomly sampled. Each test set consists of 20K sentences. 1 1 1 Datasets and model scripts are in https://github.com/kuribayashi4/typological-alignment-stackLM

为了评价(S)LMs是否泛指复杂的构造,具体来说是CSDs与诸如对象相对条款等其他的合成复杂的构造的结合,我们创建了四个带有特定构造的评价数据版本.

所有模板都扩展了基本的3-NP 2-VP和4-NP 3-VP CSD构建. Rel版本在基建中引入了对其中一个NP的相对对象条款. Conj-1和Conj-2在Rel版本顶部的相对条款内引入了坐标结构,分别带有一两个相对式. Nested在Rel版本中引入了另外一条巢相对条款.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1 Models
blocks.zh: 4.1 模式

blocks.en:
We use the model variations and implementations of DuSell and Cotterell (2025) .
As the stack module can be combined with different base architectures, we explore three base architectures: RNN, LSTM, and Transformer.
Two stack implementations of SUP and ND are examined, resulting in 6 SLM variants: {RNN, LSTM, Transformer} × \times {SUP, ND}.
All the RNN and LSTM variants have 3 layers, and Transformers have 5 layers.
For RNN and LSTM SLMs, as proposed in DuSell and Cotterell (2025) , their multi-layer implementations are adopted, and we also add a short-circuit connection from the stack-top to the final layer by default to mitigate the time-lag between stack updating and reading.
For Transformer SLMs, we examine the two-stack-layer versions adopted in DuSell and Cotterell (2025) with the potential expressivity to recognize cross-serial constructions, and sinusoidal positional encoding is used.
See Appendix B for the detailed ablations of short-circuit connection and one-stack-layer Transformer SLMs.
SUP stacks use a 50-dim stack vector, and ND use a 45-dim vector, where a 5-dim vector is assigned to nine different action histories (3 states × \times 3 stack tops).
A dropout rate of 0.1 is applied for all the models.
blocks.zh:
我们使用DuSell和Cottellell(2025年)的模型变异和实施.
由于堆栈模块可以与不同的基架构结合,我们探索三个基架构:RNN,LSTM,和变形器.
检查了SUP和ND的两堆执行,结果产生了6种SLM变体:{RNN,LSTM,变形器}×\times{SUP,ND}.
所有RNN和LSTM变体有3层,变形器有5层.
对于RNN和LSTM SLM,如DuSell和Cotterell(2025年)所提议,它们的多层执行被采纳,我们还默认地增加了从堆上到最后一层的短路连接,以减轻堆上更新和读取之间的时间间隔.
就变形器可持续土地管理而言,我们研究了DuSell和Cottell(2025年)采用的两层结构版本,其中可能具有识别跨序构造的表达性,并使用了鼻孔定位编码。
见附录 B指短路连接和单层变压器SLM的详细故障。
SUP堆栈使用50-dim堆栈向量,ND使用45-dim向量,其中5-dim向量被分配到9个不同的动作史(3 state ×\time 3 stack ups).
所有模型的辍学率为0.1。

blocks.en:
To facilitate fair comparison of models, all the (S)LMs are set to have approximately 200K parameter counts.
We ran a model-data-dependent hyperparameter search to determine minibatch size and initial learning, instead of fixing the hyperparameters across all settings.
Specifically, for each model, we run ten hyperparameter configurations and select the one with the lowest cross-entropy loss on the validation set after 10 epochs.
We adopted early stopping after no improvement over three consecutive epochs, resulting in an average of 18 training epochs.
blocks.zh:
为了便于公平比较模型,所有(S)LM被设定为拥有约200K参数计数.
我们进行了一个模型数据依赖的超参数搜索,以确定小批量大小和初始学习,而不是在所有设置中修复超参数.

We first analyze the general architectural effects over diverse word orders.
Table 3 shows the PPL averaged over 32 languages for each model and evaluation set.
These results show that stack modules do not always improve PPLs.
One notable result is the superiority of the combination of RNN and SUP stack, which yields consistently better PPLs than the base RNN across all the evaluation sets. This model also showed good generalization in other extant research DuSell and Cotterell (2025) .
In other words, at least under fixed training resources, SLMs with powerful context access (Transformer) and expressive stack implementations (nondeterministic stack) are not the best architectures for achieving good generalization.
This also shows that, in contrast to the theoretical analysis DuSell and Chiang (2023) , SLMs, even with nondeterministic stacks, do not show notable generalization ability when tested on more realistic ALs.

We then analyze how this correlation changes across different evaluation settings, especially for any advantage of stack representations.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
Despite the theoretical expressive power of ND stacks or powerful access to context of Transformers, the model achieving the best PPLs and typological alignment was the somewhat constrained RNN SUP {}_{\text{SUP}} model.
One interpretation is that the inductive bias of RNN SUP {}_{\text{SUP}} effectively regularizes learning and guides successful generalization.
This aligns with the well-known less-is-more hypothesis in human language acquisition Newport (1990) , which proposes that cognitive limitations can aid language learning.
A recent study Mita et al. (2025) shows that limited cognitive resources, i.e., working memory, often improve LMs’ grammar acquisition empirically, and our study corroborates these findings from the distinct angles of AL learning and typological alignment. However, the resource limitation adopted in our study is not dynamically relaxed during training.
Our finding is also consistent with a related study Kuribayashi et al. (2024) where working-memory-limited syntactic LMs showed better typological alignment.
blocks.zh:
尽管ND堆栈的理论表达力或强大的上下文访问变形器,但实现最佳PPL和类型校对的模型是有些受限的RNN SUP QQText{SUP}} 模型.
一种解释是,RNN SUP QQText{SUP}的诱导偏差有效地规范了学习,指导了成功的概括.
这与人类语言获取Newport(1990年)中人们所熟知的比较少的假说一致,后者提出认知限制可以帮助语言学习.
最近的一项研究Mita等人(2025年)表明,有限的认知资源,即工作记忆,往往从经验上改进LMs的语法获取,我们的研究从AL学习和类型学对等的不同角度证实了这些发现. 然而,我们的研究中所采用的资源限制在培训期间并没有动态放松。
我们的研究结果也符合Kuribayashi等人(2024年)的相关研究,其中工作-记忆-有限合成LMs显示出更好的类型一致性。

blocks.en:
However, another reason for the differences across model architectures might be training stability.
As suggested in Figure 2 , models sometimes exhibit substantial instability across the five seeds within the same data and model combination.
Note that we ensured all training was properly stopped via early stopping, so the seed variance reflects the model’s inherent instability in training.
We confirmed that, for example, ND SLMs generally exhibit greater instability than SUP SLMs (see Appendix C ); thus, the misalignment of ND SLMs could also be due to noise arising from unstable convergence, possibly because of their more complex model architectures.
From this perspective, while ND stacks may potentially be effective, we do not yet have an implementation that is robust enough to demonstrate this statistically.

我们确认,例如,与SUP SLM相比,ND SLM的不稳定性普遍较大(见附录C);因此,ND SLM的错配也可能是由于不稳定的趋同产生的噪音,可能是因为其模型结构更为复杂。
从这个角度看,虽然ND堆集可能有效,但我们还没有一个足够有力的执行,以统计方式证明这一点。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we evaluate RNN, LSTM, and Transformer LM learning of ALs with differing word order configurations focusing on generalization for test data containing cross-serial constructions.
We investigate the effect of augmenting our LMs with a stack on their inductive biases and their ability to learn and generalize.
We also investigate the alignment of LM learning with the attested typological distribution of word order configurations, and we find that the models with limited working memory, e.g., RNN SUP {}_{\text{SUP}} SLM model both performed most effectively, consistent with the less-is-more hypothesis based on human working memory limitations, and are more typologically aligned with the commonly occurring word order configurations in attested languages.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们评价了RNN,LSTM,以及变形器LM对ALs的学习,其单词顺序配置不同,重点是对包含跨序列构造的测试数据的概括.
我们调查用一堆材料来增加我们的低能率的影响,这些高能率影响其诱导性偏见及其学习和概括的能力。
我们还调查了LM学习与经证实的词序配置的字型分布的配合,我们发现,工作记忆有限的模型,如RNN SUP QQText{SUP{SUP} SLM模型,都表现得最为有效,与基于人类工作记忆限制的比较少的假说一致,并且与经证实语言中常见发生的字型配置在字型上更为一致.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
The data used in this paper are artificial, where the sentences for all the ALs consist mostly of ‘English’ word forms allowing us to abstract away from tokenization differences.
While using artificial languages provides us with an opportunity to conduct more controlled and targeted experiments, it also simplifies or excludes many other features that are found in natural languages. For instance, our current ALs exclude lexical category ambiguity — no word form is associated with both a verb or noun for example, and no word form is both an intransitive and transitive verb. Similarly, nearly all structural attachment ambiguity introduced by the combinatory rules is excluded. Further experiments should explore the effect of adding such ambiguity as well as explore a wider range of construction types.
blocks.zh:
本文使用的数据是人为的,其中所有ALs的句子大多由"英语"的单词形式组成,使我们能够抽象地摆脱象征性的区别.
虽然使用人工语言为我们提供了进行更受控制和更有针对性的实验的机会,但它也简化或排除了自然语言中发现的许多其他特征. 例如,我们目前的ALs排除了词汇类的模糊性——例如,没有任何一个词形式与动词或名词都有联系,也没有一个词形式既是一个不易变换的动词,也是一个过渡性的动词. 同样,混合规则引起的几乎所有结构附加模糊性都排除在外。 进一步的实验应探讨增加这种模糊性的效果,并探讨更广泛的建筑类型。

blocks.en:
Our results currently show that the LMs that incorporate the more expressive ND stack exhibit a higher variance in training and performance than the less expressive models like the vanilla models or the LMs with SUP stacks.
We would like to better understand the reason for this behavior and training instability in the future.
Similarly, we would like to understand why the vanilla LSTM models learn cross-serial dependencies more effectively than stack-augmented LSTMs. Further experiments should also explore the effect of hyperparameter settings on the results.
Additionally, our results are based on empirical evaluation.
To better understand the extent of SLM learning, we plan to conduct a more theoretical study in the future.
blocks.zh:
我们的结果表明,包含更显式的ND堆栈的LMs在培训和性能方面的差异大于含SUP堆栈的香草模型或LMs等不太显式的模型。
我们希望更好地了解这种行为的原因,并在今后训练不稳定.
同样,我们想了解为什么香草LSTTM模型比堆积式LSTM更有效学习跨序列依赖性. 进一步的实验还应探讨超参数设置对结果的影响。
此外,我们的成果是以经验评价为基础的。
为了更好地了解可持续土地管理的学习程度,我们计划今后进行更理论的研究。

blocks.en: Ethical Statement
blocks.zh: 道德声明

blocks.en:
The datasets used in this paper are all artificial and automatically generated.

blocks.en: A.1 Model Details
blocks.zh: A.1 示范细节

blocks.en:
We follow the model configurations in DuSell and Cotterell (2025) .
The total parameter number is adjusted to be around 200K in all the models.
All the Transformer variants have five layers with four attention heads in each layer.
All the LSTM and RNN variants have three layers.
The dropout rate is set to 0.1.
The number of tokens in minibatch [512, 2048] and the initial learning rate [ 10 − 5 10^{-5} , 10 − 3 10^{-3} ] are determined by hyperparameter tuning, following DuSell and Cotterell (2025) .
The runs for hyperparameter search continues for 5 epochs, and the best hyperparameter combination is selected among 10 different runs.
blocks.zh:
我们遵循DuSell和Cottell的模型配置(2025年).
总参数数在所有模型中调整为200K左右.
所有变形器的变体都有五层,每层有四个注意力头.
所有LSTM和RNN变种都有三层.
辍学率定为0.1。
小批量[512,2048]中的符数和初始学习率[10−5 10−5},10−3 10−3}]是由超参数调制决定的,跟随DuSell和Cottell (2025).
超参数搜索的运行持续了5个纪元,最好的超参数组合被选在10个不同的运行中.

blocks.en:

The other test data, including Medium , Long , Rel, Conj-1, Conj-2, and Nested data, have ∼ \sim 20K sentences in each set.
